small_guidance:
- Add larger BLOCK_N configs (256, 512) paired with BLOCK_OC=32 to better amortize the weight reload across more output spatial positions; the kernel is GEMM-shaped with K_TOTAL=72 (tiny) so increasing N-tile re-use is the main lever.
- Force BLOCK_K to the next pow2 of K_TOTAL (128) and add configs with num_stages=4 since the inner gather is single-pass and pipelining helps hide DRAM latency on the x_tile gather.
- Swap program-id ordering (pid_oc outer, pid_n inner) or add an L2-swizzle on the grid to improve weight tile reuse across the persistent OC dimension.
large_guidance:
- Restructure as an explicit GEMM along K (loop over IC*KH*KW with BLOCK_K=16/32 inside the kernel) instead of a single fat K tile; this lets tl.dot operate on standard 64x32 / 128x32 tiles with FMA pipelining rather than one big 64x128 outer-product that under-utilizes tensor cores.
- Tile output spatially as (BLOCK_OH x BLOCK_OW) instead of flattening N=B*OH*OW; then the kh/kw loop reuses overlapping input rows across the tile (shared halo loads), dramatically cutting the redundant x gathers that dominate at 128x128 spatial.
- Consider channels-last (NHWC) input/weight layout so the IC dimension is contiguous and the K-reduction loads coalesce; current NCHW gather has stride_xc=IH*IW=16384, which is the worst-case for vectorized loads.
